title: Permission Denied
mission: Make deploy.sh executable. Do not change what the script does.

lesson.what_happened: The file content was valid, but no executable permission bit was set.
lesson.be_careful: chmod 777 grants unnecessary access and is rarely the right fix.

hints: The long form of ls displays permission bits: ls -l deploy.sh
chmod can add the executable bit. Try researching: chmod +x
